scene: You scramble onto the metal raptor as its mechanical joints hum alive.
picture: Side-view rooftop scene along a flat tile floor. Left sits the yellow school bus. In the centre, the boy in his green striped shirt sits astride the metal raptor skeleton, holding his skateboard. Up high on its neck is a bronze lever. On the saddle's left is a folded map. Far right, an open skylight hatch sits.
